themes.name: Harvestwake
themes.motif: warm bronze entwined with amber leaves and golden wheat; a small amber lantern at the upper central crest
themes.scene: Autumn medieval valley at golden sunset, foreground cobblestone terrace framed by amber trees and small glowing lanterns, harvested fields winding down toward a river and a distant fortified fantasy city. Warm windows, subtle magical blue crystals, late golden sunlight and deep navy shadows. Expansive quiet upper sky.

themes.name: Winter's Bell
themes.motif: aged gold with silver frost filigree, tiny angular ice crystals and a small winter bell at the upper central crest
themes.scene: Snowy medieval mountain citadel at twilight, distant spires above a frozen lake and a stone bridge, soft aurora in a deep indigo sky, snow laden pines along the lower edges, welcoming warm amber windows and lanterns. A serene winter wonderland, crisp cyan ice against navy snow shadows. Large quiet upper sky.

themes.name: VELDRYN Anniversary · Firstlight
themes.motif: gold and bronze ceremonial laurel, saturated blue crystal inlays, small radiant blue diamond star at the upper central crest
themes.scene: Ancient forest kingdom at first light, a grand gold-and-stone arched bridge crossing a turquoise river toward a distant castle and luminous blue crystal obelisk, mossy ruins and deep evergreen trees at the edges, blue-and-gold unmarked ceremonial banners, tiny golden motes in morning light. Wonder and adventure with generous peaceful upper sky.

jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE full-bleed portrait 9:16 startup background illustration for VELDRYN mobile fantasy RPG. Scene: Autumn medieval valley at golden sunset, foreground cobblestone terrace framed by amber trees and small glowing lanterns, harvested fields winding down toward a river and a distant fortified fantasy city. Warm windows, subtle magical blue crystals, late golden sunlight and deep navy shadows. Expansive quiet upper sky. Style: premium carefully hand-pixelled fantasy game environment, crisp visible square pixel clusters, beautifully layered depth, atmospheric but clean pixel art. Match established VELDRYN navy, warm gold and blue crystal language. Compose for a phone: distant main landmark in central middle 45%, details along lower/side edges, upper 22% calm low-detail sky for a separately overlaid logo; bottom 15% dark quiet foreground for loading text. Keep important landmarks within central 65% width for tall-phone crop. No characters, no lettering, no logo, no UI, no border, no watermark, no photorealism, no smooth painted brush strokes. Opaque artwork filling the canvas. Portrait composition, not landscape.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent 16:9 wide profile-card border overlay for VELDRYN pixel fantasy RPG. Theme: Harvestwake. Ornament: warm bronze entwined with amber leaves and golden wheat; a small amber lantern at the upper central crest. Match supplied reference only for general medieval pixel-frame construction and aspect ratio; make this theme distinct. Thin straight warm metal rails, four substantial stepped corner ornaments, elegant readable pixel clusters, large unobstructed rectangular center. All decoration confined to outer 10% band, top crest contained in the border. No text, no portrait, no panel fill, no scene. Both entire inner rectangle AND exterior must be actual PNG alpha=0 transparency. Do NOT draw a checkerboard or black/white fill. Symmetric axis aligned full frame, all four edges visible, no shadows or glow outside. Native target320x180 logical pixels. Golden bronze, navy outlines and themed accent colors, top-left lighting. One asset only.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE individual event badge icon for VELDRYN pixel fantasy RPG. Actual transparent alpha background outside the badge. No painted checkerboard, no floor, no backdrop, no soft glow. High quality hand-pixelled game inventory icon.
